name: @soroush.design/cli
description: The command line of the @soroush.tech design system: init sets it up in an existing React app, and create starts a new one, each showing every change first.
author: Masoud Soroush <masoud@soroush.tech>

scripts.test:types: pnpm --filter @soroush.tech/design-system build && tsc -p type-tests/init/tsconfig.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-vike.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-vike-ssg.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-vike-ssr.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-vike-libraries.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-vike-jotai.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-vike-more.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-astro-ssg.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-astro-ssr.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-astro-libraries.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-astro-more.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-react-router.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-react-router-libraries.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-react-router-more.json && tsc -p type-tests/tsconfig.create-react-router-jotai.json
